config.SprinklersFillPetBowl.name: Sprinklers fill the pet bowl
config.SprinklersFillPetBowl.tooltip: Each morning, a sprinkler that reaches the pet bowl's water fills it. In co-op, the host's setting applies.
config.ConfirmWarpTotems.name: Confirm warp totems
config.ConfirmWarpTotems.tooltip: Ask before a warp totem sends you away.
config.ConfirmReturnScepter.name: Confirm Return Scepter
config.ConfirmReturnScepter.tooltip: Ask before the Return Scepter sends you home.
config.DecoratingTimeFreeze.name: Time freeze while decorating
config.DecoratingTimeFreeze.tooltip: Stop the clock inside the farmhouse or a cabin. In co-op, the host's setting applies and every player must qualify.
decorFreeze.started: Time stands still while you decorate.
config.WeddingReminder.name: Wedding reminder
config.WeddingReminder.tooltip: Get a letter on the day before your wedding.
config.WoodShelterStorage.name: Wood shelter storage
config.WoodShelterStorage.tooltip: The log pile beside the farmhouse door stores Wood and Hardwood, shared by all players.
woodShelter.inUse: Someone else is using the wood shelter.
config.StackUnusedTackle.name: Stack unused tackle
config.StackUnusedTackle.tooltip: Unused fishing tackle stacks in your backpack and chests. Worn tackle doesn't. In co-op, every player should use the same setting.
